title: WhatsApp
subtitle: Every conversation in one place: who asked about which property and who answered.

inbox.emptyHint: As soon as a lead messages your number, the conversation shows up here.
inbox.windowOpen: You can write: they replied less than 24 hours ago
inbox.windowClosed: More than 24 hours since their last message
inbox.windowHint: WhatsApp only allows free text for 24 hours after the person's last message. Outside that window an approved template is required.
inbox.noPermission: Your role can read conversations, but not reply.

settings.connectionBody: Which number your agency's messages go out from.
settings.quotaBody: How many messages your plan includes every 30 days and how many you've used.
settings.quotaExhausted: You've used up this period's messages. Automatic notices resume on their own when the next one starts.
settings.quotaNear: You're past 80% of this period's messages.
settings.templatesBody: To message someone who hasn't replied in the last 24 hours, Meta requires an approved template. There are {utility} utility ones and {marketing} marketing one.
settings.templatesDone: Done. Meta reviews them within hours, and once approved the notices go out on their own.
settings.templatesPartial: Some templates couldn't be created. Check each one's status in the list.
settings.costHint: Meta charges per conversation: about {utility} USD for utility and {marketing} USD for marketing. This is an estimate — Meta sets those rates and changes them.
settings.dispatchBody: Visit reminders and rent collection notices. They normally go out on their own; this button sends the due ones now for your account.

upsell.title: WhatsApp for your agency
upsell.body: Your {plan} plan doesn't include WhatsApp. Here's what it does and which plans have it, so you can decide with the facts in front of you.

features.lead: Replies to the lead in seconds, not hours. After 10 minutes the odds of reaching them drop by roughly 80%.
features.ficha: Sends the property sheet with photo, price, details and the link to your site — and to the virtual tour if there is one.
features.visita: Reminds the lead about the visit, and they confirm, cancel or ask to move it by replying.
features.renta: Sends rent notices five days before, on the day, and three and eight days past due.
features.match: When a property matching someone's search comes in, it lets them know — only those who asked for it.
features.inbox: Every conversation in the panel, with each message's real delivery status.

upsell.note: Included messages renew every 30 days. Meta charges per conversation and sets that rate, not DaleControl.
